assets.title: Lagos Hustle Hot Take
assets.script: Make we talk true: Lagos go humble you, but e go also build you! The hustle here no be joke – from Yaba to Victoria Island, everybody dey on their grind. But here's the thing: the same energy wey make you navigate Lagos traffic morning and evening, na e go make you build that startup, finish that project, and show up when others don give up. Lagos na school of life with no graduation date!
assets.caption:
Lagos taught me hustle, but e also taught me rest na part of the game! 🚗💨

The city go test you – traffic, heat, stress. But that same energy go build empire.

Drop '🏆' if Lagos (or any African city) trained you for success!

assets.title: From Village to Virtual
assets.script: Some of us grew up where NEPA no sure, where network dey do hide and seek, where phone na luxury. Today? We dey build apps. We dey record podcasts. We dey create AI tools for the same continent we love. Never be ashamed of your 'before' – na that story go make your 'after' sweet. From village to virtual, African excellence no get limit!
assets.caption:
From village to virtual – every step of the journey matters. 🌍✨

Some of us grew up where generator was luxury. Now we building apps and AI tools.
